rationale: Removed the unnecessary lambda wrapper in tools/omnigent_exact_artifact_probe.py; _probe_import already returns the callable.
Dropped the unused Iterable import from moonmind/omnigent/exact_artifact_conformance.py.
Dropped the unused Iterable import from moonmind/omnigent/live_verification_health.py.

Probe assets now reach the deployable image through an explicit read-only /probe mount with PYTHONPATH=/app, so no test-only asset is baked into the production image and imports still resolve from the artifact under test. The browser controller's Playwright runtime is installed on the CI host and drives the container's hosted origin. Docker runs now use the locally resolvable sha256:<image id> content id, which fixes the 'pull access denied' failure the unpullable repo digest caused.

The exact-artifact job now starts temporalio/auto-setup (the same image and configuration canonical Compose uses) on the job's PostgreSQL and waits for 127.0.0.1:7233; the worker probe requires an explicit --temporal-address and passes TEMPORAL_ADDRESS plus the POSTGRES_* settings the image actually reads.

Each migration scenario now runs against its own freshly created database (reset_database drops and recreates moonmind_exact_artifact_clean / _prior), and the prior-schema case materializes the real revision preceding head via 'alembic show head' and then upgrades, instead of stamping base over an already-migrated schema.

The fabricated booleans are gone: the fake-provider probe and the fakeProviderExecution gate section were removed rather than kept on an unrelated exit status. In their place the server probe performs a real bounded execution boundary it can observe -- docker restart of the deployable container against the schema it just migrated, requiring liveness again -- surfaced as the new required capability api_restart_against_existing_schema. Restart/terminal replay after fake-host removal is now explicitly documented as owned by the reliability-journey and embedded-recovery gates that actually exercise it, which the Omnigent contract gate selects on the same commit.

assemble_omnigent_live_status now retrieves the acceptance manifest published by the newest passing live-conformance run (select_manifest_artifact + gh run download) before evaluation, with an explicit --manifest override; a genuine absence still yields None so the projection stays fail-closed.

Added the canonical redact_secrets in moonmind/omnigent/conformance.py whose patterns span the complete credential -- the whole session-bearing header value to end of line, JWTs, cookies, bare Bearer/Basic credentials, and token bodies after known prefixes -- so redaction is no longer a header-name-only strip. Redaction runs before line truncation, assert_secret_free now also rejects the wider set of credential-bearing keys, and tests assert the published logTail passes an independent secret scan.

Added the real production API command api_service/entrypoint.sh to EXACT_ARTIFACT_EXACT, replaced the nonexistent api_service/docker/entrypoint.sh in the selector test with real repository paths, and added a guard test asserting every exact-path inventory entry exists so a typo cannot mask a coverage gap again. Also removed the nonexistent uv.lock entry and the compose entries the globs already cover.

Compose now bind-mounts ${MOONMIND_OMNIGENT_EVIDENCE_DIR:-./var/omnigent-evidence} read-only at /workspace/omnigent-evidence and defaults all three evidence refs to files inside it, so the default deployment consumes real evidence with no per-file configuration. tools/materialize_omnigent_evidence.py is the automatic materialization path: it copies the newest unexpired document published for the deployed commit into that directory, refusing evidence for another commit. Compose defaults and the mount are pinned by test_compose_foundation.

Added assert_live_health_projection and used it at the catalog consumption boundary: it validates the versioned schema, the ready verdict, the deployed commit, the projection's own age against the hourly publication cadence, and the acceptance expiry it inherits. Tests cover expired acceptance windows, a stalled publisher, and a foreign schema.

Both migration commands now pass the repository's explicit configuration (-c api_service/migrations/alembic.ini), matching the alembic-migration-gate invocation, and run with -w /app so script_location resolves.

The server and UI probes share one container lifetime: _probe_server_and_ui starts the API container, probes routes, runs the browser capture against that live hosted origin, then performs the restart probe before teardown. A test asserts the capture happens between container start and removal, and that the UI signals fail closed when the API never starts.

The hosted capture no longer counts any same-origin request. It now requires three concrete facts: a request under the image's compiled-bundle mount /static/workflow_console/dist/, a parseable #moonmind-ui-boot payload, and rendered content in #dashboard-app-root. A hermetic contract test pins each selector and the bundle prefix to the real template and static mount.

aggregate_provider_runner_fleet replaces first-match selection: the tier is online when at least one labeled runner is online, and busy only when no online runner is idle, with matching/online/idle counts reported. Tests cover an offline runner ordered ahead of an online one and mixed busy/idle fleets.
Removed unused imports in agent_profile.py; schemaVersion now constrained to v2 literal.
Generic realizer wiring is via planner trusted selection and support keys; added runtime vendor refs and full agent source digest to support payload, and planner now enforces via validate_realizer.
Planner now binds trust to exact implementation: checks trust.implementationRef == profile.harness.implementationRef and catalog implementation.
Planner now rejects launch policies outside profile allowlist via allowedLaunchPolicyRefs check.
Runtime binding now verifies digest via model_validator recomputing expected ref.
Credential binding validation now rejects extra slots via declared_slots check.
Realizer selection now trusted: ignores caller override except for explicit codex compatibility, enforced via planner.
Attestation now includes architecture field and validation checks expectedArchitecture.
Host Class registration now rejects duplicate ref with different definition, requiring new version.
Skill artifact ref now uses full digest (artifact:sha256:...) for collision resistance.
Planner now binds catalog to endpoint: checks profile.endpointRef == catalog.endpointRef and catalogRef equality.
Planner now validates bindings against slot acceptedAuthModels and provider constraints.
Attestation validator now requires expectedHostId and binds to leased host identity.
Materializer now derives accessMode from state.mutable: writable for OAuth homes.
Support classification now requires has_experimental_evidence for experimental, otherwise discovered_only.
Removed unused top-level hashlib import; now imported locally where used for support key generation.
Fixed conflict: merged main ledger entries with harness platform entries.
